none: contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete cast copper alloy enamelled Roman 'patera' or handled pan. The body of the vessel is convex and has a slightly thickened rim with a thickness of 1.8mm. One side of the vessel has sustained some damage and the rim has been pushed inwards.
